title: not only A but also B

questions.q:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
학생들뿐만 아니라 그들을 가르치는 선생님도 그 여행에 참가할 예정이다.
Not only the students but also the teacher who teaches them ____ going to join the trip.
questions.e: not only A but also B가 주어이면 동사는 B(the teacher)에 맞춰요. 관계대명사절(who teaches them)에 속지 말고 단수 is를 써요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
The coach as well as the players ____ been practicing since early morning.
questions.ko: 선수들뿐만 아니라 코치도 이른 아침부터 연습하고 있다.
questions.e: B as well as A는 앞에 있는 B(the coach)에 동사를 맞춰요. 단수라서 현재완료의 has been을 써요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
He is good at not only cooking dinner but also ____ the house afterwards.
questions.ko: 그는 저녁을 요리하는 것뿐만 아니라 그 후에 집을 청소하는 것도 잘한다.
questions.e: A와 B는 같은 모양이어야 해요. 전치사 at 뒤의 A가 동명사 cooking이라서 B도 동명사 cleaning을 써요.

questions.q:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
Not only the price but also the design of this phone surprised me.
= The design ____ the price of this phone surprised me.
questions.e: not only A but also B = B as well as A예요. 강조되는 B(the design)가 앞으로 오고 그 뒤에 as well as A가 와요.

o: Not only my parents but also my little brother was surprised at the news.
Not only my parents but also my little brother were surprised at the news.
My brother as well as my parents were surprised at the news.
She not only sings well but also dance beautifully.
He can neither swim or skate, so he stays home in summer.
questions.e: not only A but also B가 주어이면 B(my little brother)에 맞춰 was를 써요. B as well as A도 B(my brother)에 맞춰 was, A와 B는 같은 모양(sings/dances), neither는 nor와 짝이에요.

questions.q:
대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 순서대로 고르세요.
A: Can your grandfather use a smartphone or a computer?
B: No. He can use ____ a smartphone ____ a computer, so he still writes letters.
questions.ko: B: 아니. 그는 스마트폰도 컴퓨터도 사용하지 못하셔서 여전히 편지를 쓰셔.
questions.e: 'A도 B도 아닌'은 neither A nor B로 써요. 대답이 No라서 either A or B나 both A and B는 뜻이 맞지 않아요.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: Not only the books but also the desk in the classroom were moved yesterday.
Tom as well as his classmates is going to the museum tomorrow.
Not only I but also my friends are interested in the science project.
Both the key and the wallet were found under the sofa.
He likes not only reading novels but also writing short stories.
questions.e: not only A but also B가 주어이면 동사는 B(the desk)에 맞춰야 해요. → Not only the books but also the desk in the classroom was moved yesterday.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: She wants not only to travel abroad but also learning new languages.
The restaurant is popular not only with students but also with office workers.
You can neither eat nor drink in the school library.
Not only Jane but also her cousins have visited Jeju since 2020.
You can choose either the red one or the blue one.
questions.e: A와 B는 같은 모양이어야 해요. A가 to부정사(to travel)라서 B도 to부정사로 써요. → She wants not only to travel abroad but also to learn new languages.

questions.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
o: My uncle can play not only the guitar but also he plays the drums.
My sister as well as I was late for the first class this morning.
Not only the teacher but also the students were tired after the long trip.
He is famous not only in Korea but also in Japan and China.
Both my parents and my grandmother are coming to the school festival.
questions.e: not only A but also B에서 A와 B는 같은 모양이어야 해요. A가 명사(the guitar)인데 B에 절이 왔어요. → My uncle can play not only the guitar but also the drums.

questions.q:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. (세 단어)
Not only the teacher but also the students were tired after the long trip.
= The students ____ the teacher were tired after the long trip.
questions.ko: 선생님뿐만 아니라 학생들도 긴 여행 후에 피곤했다.
questions.e: not only A but also B는 B as well as A로 바꿔요. 강조되는 B(the students)가 앞으로 와요.

questions.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 be동사를 현재형으로 쓰세요.
Not only his parents but also he ____ learning Spanish these days.
questions.ko: 그의 부모님뿐만 아니라 그도 요즘 스페인어를 배우고 있다.
questions.e: not only A but also B가 주어이면 동사는 B(he)에 맞춰요. 그래서 is를 써요.

questions.q:
괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰세요.
I'm interested in not only drawing pictures but also ____ music. (make)
questions.ko: 나는 그림을 그리는 것뿐만 아니라 음악을 만드는 것에도 관심이 있다.
questions.e: A(drawing)가 동명사라서 B도 같은 모양인 동명사 making을 써요.

questions.q: Not only my friends but also I is going to the concert tonight.
questions.ko: 내 친구들뿐만 아니라 나도 오늘 밤 콘서트에 갈 것이다.
questions.e: not only A but also B가 주어이면 동사는 B(I)에 맞춰요. is → am

questions.q: My sister as well as my parents are planning to visit Busan this summer.
questions.ko: 내 부모님뿐만 아니라 내 언니도 이번 여름에 부산을 방문할 계획이다.
questions.e: B as well as A는 앞에 있는 B(my sister)에 동사를 맞춰요. are planning → is planning

questions.q: He enjoys not only playing soccer but also to watch it on TV.
questions.ko: 그는 축구를 하는 것뿐만 아니라 TV로 그것을 보는 것도 즐긴다.
questions.e: A와 B는 같은 모양이어야 해요. A가 동명사(playing)라서 B도 동명사로 써요. to watch → watching

questions.ko: 지난주에 그 소식은 학생들뿐만 아니라 선생님들도 놀라게 했다.
ans: Last week, the news surprised not only the students but also the teachers.
The news surprised not only the students but also the teachers last week.
questions.e: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'는 not only A but also B로 짝을 맞춰 목적어 자리에 써요. 강조되는 B(the teachers)가 뒤에 와요.

questions.ko: 선생님뿐만 아니라 학생들도 지금 그 축제를 즐기고 있다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: The students as well as the teacher are enjoying the festival now.
Now the students as well as the teacher are enjoying the festival.
Now, the students as well as the teacher are enjoying the festival.
questions.e: B as well as A는 앞에 있는 B(the students)에 동사를 맞춰요. 복수라서 be → are로 바꿔요.

questions.ko: 내 여동생뿐만 아니라 나도 어제 그 영화를 봤다.
questions.cond: 주어진 말을 이용하고, 필요하면 단어를 더하거나 형태를 바꾸세요.
ans: Not only my sister but also I watched the movie yesterday.
Yesterday, not only my sister but also I watched the movie.
Yesterday not only my sister but also I watched the movie.
questions.e: not only A but also B를 주어로 쓰고, yesterday가 있어서 watch를 과거형 watched로 바꿔요.
